title: SPARK: Jailbreaking T2V Models by Synergistically Prompting Auditory and Recontextualized Knowledge

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of adversarial jailbreak prompts designed to bypass safety guardrails and force the text-to-video (T2V) models to generate discriminatory content (as one of the 14 safety hazard categories evaluated).
